8t259ch3144w.body: Users whose traffic was served from our Dallas, Chicago, and San Jose Points of Presence (POPs) experienced redirect loops. Only a subset of customers who have the option to redirect would be affected. This was caused by cache configuration changes at those locations. We reverted those changes, redirect behavior returned to normal, and the issue is resolved.
8t259ch3144w.title: Regional Issue with Web Request Redirect Loop

cn25g594jq7f.body: Additional mitigations have restored traffic and latency to normal levels in the affected regions. We will continue routine monitoring. This incident is resolved.
